opportunities.best_time: 日落前約2小時至園區當日允許停留的日落後短時段；以NPS當日關門與道路狀態為準

condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"White Sands Sunset Stroll / nearby Dunes Drive Camera Zone","target":"gypsum dunes + sunset sky + surrounding mountain context"}

condition_variants.boosters: 黃金時段低角度光；日落後山體粉紅餘暉；雲層色彩；新鮮風紋
condition_variants.penalties: 強風吹沙；能見度過低；強降水；極端高溫；道路／園區臨時關閉
